title: A convergent Scharfetter-Gummel scheme for a three-species drift-diffusion model for memristors
summary: A structure-preserving fully implicit Scharfetter-Gummel finite-volume scheme for a three-species drift-diffusion model for semiconductors is proposed and analyzed. The equations describe the evolution of the electron, hole, and oxygen vacancy densities in a (bounded) memristor device, coupled to the Poisson equation for the electric potential, with mixed-type boundary conditions. Recasting the Scharfetter-Gummel fluxes in an upwind form, a hidden Fisher information component is revealed.
